ov: بوسيدون (الإنجليزية: Poseidon) هو فيلم مغامرات أمريكي من انتاج عام 2006 وإخراج ولفغانغ بيترسن وثالث الأفلام المقتبسة من رواية بول غاليكو مغامرة بوسيدون ، و طبعة جديدة من الفيلم الذي يحمل نفس الاسم عام 1972 , بطولة كورت راسل وجوش لوكاس, تم إنتاجها وتوزيعها من قبل وارنر بروس بالتعاون مع استوديوهات فيرشوتيل . اصدر الفيلم في شكل آيماكس. تم إصداره في 12 مايو 2006، ورشح في جوائز الأوسكار ال 79 لأفضل المؤثرات البصرية. وحققت بوسيدون 181,674,817 دولار في شباك التذاكر في جميع أنحاء العالم بميزانية قدرها 160 مليون دولار
plotEn:
The Poseidon, a luxury cruise ship, is making a transatlantic crossing from London to New York City. Former New York City Mayor and firefighter Robert Ramsey travels to New York with his daughter Jennifer and her boyfriend Christian Sanders, who are soon to be engaged. Also on board are former Navy submariner-turned-professional gambler Dylan Johns, architect Richard Nelson, Maggie James and her son Conor, stowaway Elena Morales, her waiter boyfriend Marco Valentine, singer Gloria, and Captain Michael Bradford
While most of the passengers are in the ballroom celebrating at a New Year's Eve party, officers on the bridge spot a massive rogue wave heading toward the ship. In an attempt to survive the impact, they try to steer the vessel to starboard to take the wave head-on, but she does not turn fast enough. The wave swamps and capsizes the ship, flipping it completely upside down and killing the bridge officers along with numerous passengers and crew members. In the ballroom, Robert and several officers rescue Conor from a piano bolted to what is now the ceiling. Meanwhile, in the nightclub, Jennifer finds Christian pinned under fallen lighting equipment and convinces Elena to help free him. They, along with a gambler named "Lucky" Larry, are the only ones who avoid electrocution when broken wires electrify the rising water from the activated sprinkler system. Back in the ballroom, a badly injured Captain Bradford attempts to restore order. He assures the surviving passengers
